items.source: To be registered as custom TargetSourceCreator for an auto-proxy creator, in combination with custom interceptors for specific beans or for the creation of lazy-init proxies only. For example, as an autodetected infrastructure bean in an XML application context definition:
items.translation: 要注册为自动代理创建器的自定义 `TargetSourceCreator`，并结合针对特定 Bean 的自定义拦截器或仅用于创建懒加载代理。例如，在 XML 应用程序上下文定义中作为自动检测的基础设施 Bean：

items.source: Subclasses must implement this method to return a new AbstractPrototypeBasedTargetSource if they wish to create a custom TargetSource for this bean, or null if they are not interested it in, in which case no special target source will be created. Subclasses should not call setTargetBeanName or setBeanFactory on the AbstractPrototypeBasedTargetSource: This class' implementation of getTargetSource() will do that.
items.translation: 子类必须实现此方法，以返回一个新的 `AbstractPrototypeBasedTargetSource`（如果它们希望为此 bean 创建自定义的 `TargetSource`），或返回 `null`（如果它们对此不感兴趣），在这种情况下将不会创建特殊的 target source。子类不应在 `AbstractPrototypeBasedTargetSource` 上调用 `setTargetBeanName` 或 `setBeanFactory`：此类的 `getTargetSource()` 实现会执行这些操作。

items.source: Subclasses must implement this method to return a new AbstractPrototypeBasedTargetSource if they wish to create a custom TargetSource for this bean, or null if they are not interested it in, in which case no special target source will be created.
items.translation: 子类必须实现此方法，如果它们希望为此 Bean 创建自定义的 TargetSource，则返回一个新的 AbstractPrototypeBasedTargetSource；否则返回null（即不感兴趣），在这种情况下将不会创建特殊的目标源。

items.source: Return whether this TargetSourceCreator is prototype-based.
items.translation: 返回该 TargetSourceCreator 是否为原型模式。

items.source: beanClass - the class of the bean to create a TargetSource for
items.translation: beanClass - 用于创建 TargetSource 的 Bean 的类。

items.translation: AbstractPrototypeBasedTargetSource，或者如果我们不匹配此内容则为null。
